evidencePolicy: Never mark a review complete before personally inspecting the real rendered video. Scripts can detect technical faults, but cannot judge storytelling or visual quality alone.
metricsPolicy: Track YouTube Studio first-30s retention, per-video dips/spikes, average percentage viewed and click-through when available. Compare only similar formats and durations. Mark unavailable data as unavailable; never invent results.

activeRules.title: Purposeful grounded visual world
activeRules.requirement: Every scene is a believable child-scale place, its visual elements illustrate that exact movement. Vary visual zone/pose/mood rather than repeating empty CGI courts.

activeRules.title: Thumbnail never replaces the greeting
activeRules.requirement: The cover stays outside the MP4; scene 02 greets the viewer naturally with HELLO, then concise safety and start.

activeRules.title: Real Flow output checked immediately
activeRules.requirement: For every requested image check actual PNG, save with exact number, verify missing scenes, retry ONLY missing real outputs and do not overwrite or relabel existing scenes.

activeRules.title: Each scene performs a teaching job
activeRules.requirement: Each image prompt must show how the child understands the learning point, with correct annotations or diagram when useful. Never add a mascot or decoration instead of explaining.

activeRules.title: Practice, reveal and scientific accuracy
activeRules.requirement: Verify learning facts and explanations, include an age-appropriate practice question and explanation of the answer.

candidateExperiments.title: Brief guided pose entry vs static 20-second holds
candidateExperiments.note: Requires tested animation/audio/render contract; do not synthesize movement from a still or silently change production timing.

candidateExperiments.title: Compact render-side GET READY overlays vs Flow typography
candidateExperiments.note: Needs coordinated image, prompt, overlay and postrender checks; evaluate phone readability.

candidateExperiments.title: Small age-safe instruction prompts throughout movement sections
candidateExperiments.note: Requires recorded voice and verified audio-aligned captions; do not invent spoken lines in SRT.
